title: Dramatica Storyform Transport Profile
description: The foundational NCP profile and minimal transport contract for an already-created Dramatica Storyform representation. It does not encode the Dramatica Semantic Model or semantic validation rules.
$comment: The Dramatica Storyform Profile is maintained by The Dramatica Co. Its foundational status does not make it mandatory for NCP Core documents.

dsm_version.description: Semantic-model version declared by the system that produced the representation.

storyform.description: An existing Storyform representation. Field meanings are external to NCP Core and this structural schema.

fields.description: Opaque Dramatica field values preserved without inference, normalization, completion, or semantic validation.
